intro.title: An amateur weather portal, since 2014
intro.p1: emme-effe meteo gathers readings from the weather stations on the Piné Plateau (Trento, Italy), run by local weather enthusiast Lorenzo Mercurio Fedel.
intro.p2: All the project's stations are part of the A.P.S. Meteo Trentino Alto Adige association network.

customerArea.privacySummary:
Controller: Emme-Effe Services di Lorenzo Mercurio Fedel, Via dello Stadio 7, Baselga di Piné (TN), Italy. Privacy contact: elaborazione@emmeeffeservices.it.
Your name, email, protected credentials, project and consultation requests are used to manage your account and requested services (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). These details are necessary for the account and are not used for marketing. Technical hosting and email providers process data to deliver the service as described in the full policy.
Name/project and logo become public on assigned stations. Search engine indexing is a separate choice that you can change.
Account data is kept during the service. Deletion removes your profile, requests and uploaded logo; station measurements remain. Verification links expire after 24 hours; sessions after 8 hours. For technical logs, backups, recipients and transfers, consult the full policy.
You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and object where applicable under Articles 15–22 GDPR, and complain to the Italian data protection authority.
customerArea.termsSummary: The customer area lets you manage your profile and request advice. Registration does not entail purchases or automatic station assignments. Purchases and services are agreed separately. Keep your credentials secure, provide accurate information and upload only images you are entitled to publish.
